cases.name: partial payment reduces outstanding
cases.expect: Outstanding on that charge becomes 60000; paid_paise includes 40000

cases.name: credit after partial
cases.given: After A1, credit 10000 on the same charge

cases.name: duplicate idempotency key
cases.given: Retry POST /payments with same Idempotency-Key and payload

cases.name: concurrent allocations safe

cases.expect: One succeeds; other 409 fees.error.allocation_exceeds_available; payment not double-spent

cases.name: reversal restores balance
cases.given: Reverse the 40000 payment with reason + expected_version + recent 2FA

cases.name: overpayment tracked as credit
cases.given: Payment amount exceeds allocated charge balances

cases.name: bus source_key conflict
cases.given: Raise bus charge with existing source_key but different amount

cases.name: opening totals match import
cases.expect: Statement charged_paise includes 25000; no second ledger

cases.name: no float rounding
cases.given: All amounts integer paise throughout charge/pay/credit/reverse
